::: {#rem-mutual-information-kl}
#### Mutual information as a divergence

@cover2006elements [section 2.3] define mutual information
as the [Kullback--Leibler divergence](https://morrison-lab.github.io/pds/expectation.html#def-kl-divergence)
of the product of the marginals of $(X, Y)$ from their joint distribution,
and show that this equals $\entropyf{Y} - \entropyf{Y \mid X}$ [@cover2006elements, section 2.4]. <!-- check-term-links: allow -->
@thm-mutual-information-kl proves the equality with $\entropyf{Y} - \entropyf{Y \mid X}$,
and @thm-mutual-information-nonnegative proves that $I(X; Y) \ge 0$
[@cover2006elements, section 2.6].
Learning $X$ never raises the [entropy](https://morrison-lab.github.io/pds/expectation.html#def-entropy) of $Y$ on average (@cor-conditioning-reduces-entropy). <!-- check-term-links: allow -->

:::
